# Nos Astra

> Nos Astra is a small, independent software and AI studio in Njivice, Croatia. It helps lab teams use AI and automation, runs practical AI workshops, and builds websites and business tools for small businesses.

Founder: Tamara Martinovic, PhD — https://tamara.rocks
Contact: hello@nosastra.co

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.nosastra.co/): the studio and its three areas of work.
- [AI for labs](https://www.nosastra.co/labs): AI training for scientists, automations for lab data, literature and reports, and small custom tools for lab and life-science teams (pharma, biotech, CROs, testing and QC labs). Starts with a free 20-minute Lab AI Check.
- [Start](https://www.nosastra.co/en/start): a launch package for new businesses (website, basic SEO, business card design, business email setup and a quote app).
- [Privacy policy](https://www.nosastra.co/privacy.html)

## AI for labs

Tamara spent about 15 years in biomedical research before she started coding at 35. She now builds AI and automation for lab teams. Typical work: turning instrument exports into cleaned values in a report template, extracting literature tables from PDFs with a page reference for every value, and small internal tools. Privacy approach: much lab automation needs no AI and runs on the lab's own systems; sensitive parts are removed before AI reads anything; business plans with clear data terms rather than free chatbots; a local model for really sensitive work.

Book a free Lab AI Check: https://calendly.com/tamara-nosastra/lab-ai-check

## AI workshops and training

Practical AI workshops for teens and adults run through Tamara's academy: https://www.thessia.academy

## Websites and business tools

Websites, custom business tools and automations for small businesses, plus the Start package for new businesses.

## Notes

Clients work directly with Tamara from the first conversation through to the finished product. Nos Astra starts with the problem and builds the smallest useful solution.
